heading: Maximum contingent liability

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The maximum contingent liability of the Corporation outstanding at any one time shall not exceed in the aggregate $205,000,000,000.

tree.heading: Rule of construction
tree.text: The maximum contingent liability shall apply to all extension of liability by the Corporation regardless of the authority cited thereto.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2025—Pub. L. 119–60 amended section generally. Prior to amendment, text of section read as follows: “The maximum contingent liability of the Corporation outstanding at any one time shall not exceed in the aggregate $60,000,000,000.”
